# --instructions--

Escreva uma função `newcomers` que recebe dois arrays de strings (omita os rótulos dos argumentos), `today` e `yesterday`, e retorna os nomes que aparecem em `today` mas não em `yesterday`, sem duplicatas e em ordem crescente

# --before-seed--

```swift
// DO NOT EDIT FROM HERE
import Foundation

var _testCount = 0
var _testFailedCount = 0
func tryCatch(_ assertion: Bool) {
    _testCount += 1
    if !assertion {
        _testFailedCount += 1
        print("Test Case '--err-t\(_testCount)--' failed")
    }
}
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --asserts--

`newcomers(["ada", "bob", "ada", "cy"], ["bob"])` deve retornar `["ada", "cy"]`

```swift
tryCatch(newcomers(["ada", "bob", "ada", "cy"], ["bob"]) == ["ada", "cy"])
```

`newcomers(["zed", "amy"], [])` deve retornar `["amy", "zed"]`

```swift
tryCatch(newcomers(["zed", "amy"], []) == ["amy", "zed"])
```

`newcomers(["ada", "bob"], ["bob", "ada", "cy"])` deve retornar um array vazio

```swift
tryCatch(newcomers(["ada", "bob"], ["bob", "ada", "cy"]) == [])
```

A função deve retornar um array de strings

```swift
tryCatch(type(of: newcomers(["a"], ["b"])) == [String].self)
```

# --after-asserts--

```swift
print("Executed \(_testCount) tests, with \(_testFailedCount) failures")
```

# --solutions--

```swift
func newcomers(_ today: [String], _ yesterday: [String]) -> [String] {
    return Set(today).subtracting(yesterday).sorted()
}
```
